activity_summary: You came home and shut the door on the yard. You did not give the house a title, and you did not give them the death. Alse saw a smear of paint and sent you to the cold basin. Mistress Ansell had lit the hall candle, and offered broth and the crabs already in the house. Gib was by the fire. The bundle was as you had left it. You said you had nothing for the house.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Shut the door on the yard, washed, and carried no story to the table.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Asked once, lit the hall, and kept supper to what the house already had.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Named the smear, set the cold water, and checked the bundle.

entities.name: the hall candle

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I have none for this house.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: I am not lighting a second candle for a story.

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: It is as you left it.
